protocol.title: Multilayer Hybrid Microfluidics: A Digital-to-Channel Interface for Sample Processing and Separations
protocol.platform: Multilayer hybrid DMF (two-plate digital microfluidics + glass microchannel electrophoresis)
protocol.objective: On-chip serial dilution calibration curves and multistep enzymatic protein digestion (pepsin + trypsin) with in-line CE-LIF separation, demonstrating a second-generation multilayer hybrid microfluidic device architecture

device.configuration: Multilayer hybrid (two-plate DMF on top, glass microchannel network below)

substrates.substrate_1: ITO + Teflon-AF coated glass cover (top plate, ground electrode)
substrates.substrate_2: Chromium electrodes + Parylene-C + Teflon-AF on glass (bottom DMF plate / microchannel cover)
substrates.substrate_3: Glass slide with etched microchannel network (Caliper Life Science)

microchannels.pattern: cross for injection + 3 cm separation column

digital_channel_interface.principle: Droplet driven to interface electrode spontaneously wets exposed glass and settles into hole; transfers to microchannel below

analyte_stock.composition: 1 uM fluorescein + 1 uM rhodamine 123 in 20 mM borate buffer pH 9.0
analyte_stock.role: Combined analyte and internal standard stock droplet for serial dilution

diluent.composition: 1 uM rhodamine 123 in 20 mM borate buffer pH 9.0
diluent.role: Diluent maintaining constant internal standard while halving analyte concentration per dilution step

internal_standard_rhodamine123.composition: 1 uM rhodamine 123 in 20 mM borate buffer pH 9.0
internal_standard_rhodamine123.role: Declared in manifest; internal standard reference (co-present in Diluent and AnalyteFluorescein stock)

af_bsa.composition: 20 ug/mL Alexa Fluor 488-labeled bovine serum albumin in DI water + 0.1% w/v Pluronic F-68
af_bsa.role: Model protein substrate for multistep enzymatic digestion

pepsin_solution.composition: 1 mg/mL pepsin in 1 mM acetate buffer + 0.1% w/v Pluronic F-68, pH 4.5
pepsin_solution.role: First-stage protease; generates multiply charged peptide fragments

trypsin_solution.composition: 1 mg/mL trypsin in 50 mM borate buffer + 0.1% w/v Pluronic F-68, pH 9.0
trypsin_solution.role: Second-stage protease; reduces multiply charged pepsin fragments to singly charged peptides

pluronic_f68.role: Surfactant additive in all protein-containing droplets to minimise surface adsorption to Parylene-C/Teflon-AF

separation_buffer.preparation: Dissolved in 18 MOhm cm deionised water, filtered through 0.2 um nylon membrane, degassed by ultrasonication 5 min
separation_buffer.role: Fills microchannel network prior to DMF actuation; drives EOF for CE separations

steps.name: Dispense analyte stock droplet
steps.notes: Combined 1 uM fluorescein + 1 uM rhodamine 123 stock. Single unit droplet dispensed from 5x5 mm reservoir electrode.

steps.name: Dispense first diluent droplet
steps.notes: Contains only 1 uM rhodamine 123 (internal standard); no fluorescein analyte.

steps.name: Merge stock and diluent; circular mixing for Dilution 1
steps.notes: Circular mixing pattern across several electrodes ensures homogeneous 2x dilution of analyte before split.

steps.name: Split: Daughter A (Dilution 1) for CE-LIF analysis
steps.notes: Physical split by reversing electrode sequence while droplet straddles two driving electrodes. Daughter A driven to digital-channel interface for CE injection. BioScript abstraction: short mix with diluent placeholder.

steps.name: Stored Daughter B placeholder (Dilution 1 stored half)
steps.notes: Logical placeholder for the retained half-droplet (Daughter B) stored on the electrode array pending the second dilution step. Not a biological dispense event.

steps.name: CE-LIF detection at digital-channel interface (Dilution 1)
steps.notes: Droplet spontaneously wets drilled hole (2 mm dia.) and transfers to microchannel below. DC voltages applied by LabSmith high-voltage sequencer.

steps.name: Dispense second diluent; merge with stored Daughter B for Dilution 2
steps.notes: Previous analysed droplet removed from channel by suction (fine needle + vacuum flask) without removing DMF top-plate. Stored Daughter B merged with fresh diluent for 4x dilution of original stock.

steps.name: Split: Daughter C (Dilution 2) for CE-LIF analysis
steps.notes: Daughter C driven to digital-channel interface for second CE-LIF injection.

steps.name: CE-LIF detection at digital-channel interface (Dilution 2)
steps.notes: Second CE-LIF run; completes the 3-point calibration curve (stock, 2x, 4x dilution).

steps.name: Serial dilution QC gate
steps.notes: QC keyed on dilutionSignal1 (first daughter; highest fluorescein signal, most reliable peak). Both branches normalise to dispose in IR (drain -> dispose compiler behaviour).

steps.name: dilutionJoin: dispose QC signals, enter protein digestion branch
steps.notes: Both dilution signal droplets disposed. Control passes to Protocol 2.

steps.name: Dispense AF-BSA droplet
steps.notes: 20 ug/mL AF-BSA in DI water + 0.1% F-68. Dispensed from 5x5 mm reservoir electrode.

steps.name: Dispense pepsin droplet
steps.notes: 1 mg/mL pepsin in 1 mM acetate buffer pH 4.5 + 0.1% F-68.

steps.name: Merge AF-BSA with pepsin
steps.notes: Equal volume merge; brief on-chip mixing ensures homogeneous enzyme-substrate contact.

steps.name: Pepsin digestion incubation
steps.notes: Device stored in humidified Petri dish (water-saturated wipe) to limit evaporation during incubation. AF-BSA peak at t=58 s absent after digestion, confirming complete cleavage.

steps.name: Split: Daughter D (pepsin digest) for CE-LIF analysis
steps.compiler_note: pepsinDroplet1[0] reused here as split-abstraction partner; this is a compiler-accepted workaround, not a biological dispense. The second argument represents the retained half-droplet on the array.
steps.notes: Daughter D driven to digital-channel interface for CE-LIF analysis of pepsin-only digest.

steps.name: Stored pepsin digest half-droplet placeholder
steps.notes: Logical placeholder for retained half-droplet (Daughter E) stored on electrode array. Not a biological dispense; models the pepsin digest subdroplet awaiting trypsin addition.

steps.name: CE-LIF detection: pepsin-only digest
steps.expected_result: Multiple peaks at range of elution times; intact AF-BSA peak at t=58 s absent (complete digestion)
steps.notes: CE in 100 mM borate pH 9.0; LIF at 488 nm / 536/40 nm. Previous sample removed by suction before injection.

steps.name: Dispense trypsin droplet
steps.notes: 1 mg/mL trypsin in 50 mM borate buffer pH 9.0 + 0.1% F-68.

steps.name: Merge stored pepsin digest with trypsin
steps.notes: Stored Daughter E (pepsin digest) merged with trypsin for second-stage sequential digestion.

steps.name: Trypsin digestion incubation
steps.notes: Second 30 min incubation in humidified chamber. Trypsin cleaves Lys and Arg, reducing multiply charged pepsin fragments. Total process time ~2 h including both digestions.

steps.name: Split: Daughter F (sequential digest) for CE-LIF analysis
steps.compiler_note: trypsinDroplet1[0] reused here as split-abstraction partner; same workaround as P2-S5.
steps.notes: Daughter F driven to digital-channel interface for CE-LIF analysis of sequential pepsin+trypsin digest.

steps.name: CE-LIF detection: sequential pepsin + trypsin digest
steps.expected_result: New series of peaks eluting closer together relative to pepsin-only trace; singly charged peptides from trypsin cleavage
steps.notes: Third CE run completing the three-state AF-BSA comparison (undigested, pepsin-only, pepsin+trypsin).

steps.name: Protein digestion QC gate
steps.notes: QC keyed on pepsin-only signal (loss of intact AF-BSA peak is primary assay endpoint). Both branches normalise to dispose in IR.

steps.name: finalCleanup: dispose QC signals; experiment ends
steps.notes: Terminal block. NOP is standard compiler padding at CFG exit node.

improvement_vs_side_on.note: Improvement attributed to glass channel material vs PDMS in prior design; glass reduces band broadening

conditions_tested: Pepsin + trypsin sequential digest (30 min each)
protein_digestion.pepsin_result: Complete digestion confirmed; AF-BSA peak at t=58 s absent; multiple peaks from multiply charged aromatic peptides
protein_digestion.trypsin_result: Reduction of multiply charged peptides; new series of peaks eluting closer together

bioscript.duration_units: s and m only (BioScript restriction; h not supported)

known_compiler_behaviours.drain_normalises_to_dispose: drain statements compile to dispose() in IR; expected behaviour
known_compiler_behaviours.split_abstraction: BioScript has no native split statement. Physical droplet splits are encoded as short mix operations (2s) using a previously-dispensed placeholder as the second argument. Affects IR lines 15 and 21 where pepsinDroplet1[0] and trypsinDroplet1[0] appear reused. Compiler accepts without error; biological intent documented here.
